overloads.semanticRole: The WEB SET HOME PAGE command allows you to modify the custom home page for the current Web process.

constraints: Passing an empty string "" in homePage stops sending a custom home page for the current Web process (reverts to the default home page from Database Settings).
If the named page does not yet exist when the Web process first accesses it, the Web server creates it with the default home page's contents.
The custom home page applies only to the current Web process, so it can vary per connected user.
